scope_differences: Negative and mitigating indicator identities are not fields of DetectionResultResponse v1; the result surface presents only the per-rule SUPPRESSED outcome in the DETAILED view and records the gap as an open decision.
Supporting observations and spans are not fields of DetectionResultResponse v1; observation provenance is stated as not exposed, never reconstructed.
Per-action reason identifiers and priority are not fields of RecommendedActionView; actions are shown by governed action code with a policy-basis statement only.
AI provenance is read from EvaluationResponse.ai_usage (getEvaluation), the only accepted AI field; there is no AI field in the result.
The P7-WP2 open decision on an AI-assisted analysis_mode choice is carried, not resolved here.

recovery_vocabulary.meaning: Repeat the same read; a read changes nothing.
Repeat the same read later, honouring any returned Retry-After; no countdown is invented.
Read the authoritative Evaluation state before choosing a presentation.
Correct the request (for example the view selector) before any new read.
Re-establish authentication, then repeat the read.
Do not retry the read; show the governed state only.

rules.meaning: Evaluation accepted and waiting; no result exists yet and no outcome is implied.
Evaluation executing; no result exists yet and no outcome is implied.
A result may be read; only a successful result response is presented, and readiness is not a verdict.
Evaluation failed and produced no result; the categorical failure reason is shown and is never a classification.
The result was removed under governance; governed unavailability, distinct from empty or not found.

result_presentation_states.meaning: Authoritative evaluation state is missing, inaccessible or inconsistent; no result, pending, failure or safety inference.
The response lacks a required field, carries an unrecognised value, contradicts itself or does not match the requested evaluation; the decision is withheld and nothing is guessed.
The response view or its fields do not match the view requested and authorized for this caller; the payload is discarded and an authorized response is required.
No confirmed successful result response was observed; any result-shaped data is discarded and nothing is inferred.

classification_presentation.label: No governed scam pattern established
classification_presentation.meaning: No governed scam pattern was established from the evidence evaluated. This is not a determination that the content is safe or legitimate.

classification_presentation.label: Insufficient evidence to conclude
classification_presentation.meaning: TrustLens could not reach a conclusion from the evidence evaluated. This is not a determination that the content is safe.

classification_presentation.label: Scam pattern suspected
classification_presentation.meaning: A governed scam pattern matched with low detection confidence; the uncertainty shown with this result remains.

classification_presentation.label: Scam pattern detected
classification_presentation.meaning: A governed scam pattern matched the evidence evaluated. This is not a legal finding, an official determination or proof of guilt.

classification_presentation.label: Not evaluated: unsupported input
classification_presentation.meaning: The input is outside the supported detection scope and was not evaluated. This is not a determination that the content is safe.

classification_presentation.label: Evaluation error: no conclusion
classification_presentation.meaning: The evaluation stopped without reaching a conclusion. This is not a determination that the content is safe.

input_support_presentation.label: Supported input
input_support_presentation.meaning: The input was within the supported detection scope and was evaluated.

input_support_presentation.label: Partially supported input
input_support_presentation.meaning: Part of the input could not be used; only the available evidence was evaluated and the gap is listed with this result.

input_support_presentation.label: Unsupported input
input_support_presentation.meaning: The input is outside the supported detection scope and was not evaluated.

input_support_presentation.label: Insufficient information
input_support_presentation.meaning: The input was supported but too little could be observed to evaluate any governed pattern.

input_support_presentation.label: Evaluation error
input_support_presentation.meaning: The input could not be evaluated safely; no conclusion was reached.

rule_outcome_presentation.label: Matched
rule_outcome_presentation.meaning: The governed rule's required combination matched the evidence evaluated.

rule_outcome_presentation.label: Could not be determined
rule_outcome_presentation.meaning: A decisive part of the rule could not be resolved; the uncertainty is carried forward and is not a finding.

rule_outcome_presentation.label: Suppressed by a governed suppression
rule_outcome_presentation.meaning: The rule matched and was then cancelled by a governed suppression; it is not an active finding and not proof of safety.

rule_outcome_presentation.label: Not applicable or not evaluated
rule_outcome_presentation.meaning: The rule did not apply to this input or could not be evaluated; this is not a finding and not proof of safety.

rule_outcome_presentation.label: Did not match
rule_outcome_presentation.meaning: The rule's required combination did not match; this is not a finding and not proof of safety.

rule_kind_presentation.meaning: A governed detection rule; only a MATCHED composite rule is a finding.
A governed suppression rule; whatever its state, it is never a scam finding and never proof of safety.

ai_presentation.statement: AI may indirectly affect the deterministic result only through validated governed observations; it cannot directly set, override or bypass the deterministic decision.

recommended_action_presentation.reason_statement: Recommended by the governed action policy in the knowledge bundle identified in this result's provenance.

review_findings.summary: Rendering not bound to the actual caller: a USER requesting STANDARD could be shown a DETAILED payload (section G)
Lifecycle accepted a builder self-review as independent approval
Non-success response kinds (NONE, TIMEOUT, unknown) could render cached result fields as READY
Finding eligibility ignored rule kind: a SUPPRESSION-kind MATCHED rule was shown as an active scam finding
Scenarios could not carry the six result axes, so contradictory envelopes (e.g. DETECTED with LOW confidence) rendered
Wording scan stripped uppercase tokens and accepted unrelated negation, letting unsupported display titles pass
Re-raised MEDIUM-1: an approval reference was accepted on the section title alone; the referenced GATE-028 section need not contain the review record
Re-raised MEDIUM-3: matched, governing and per-rule references were compared by count only, so mismatched rule identities rendered READY
A presence flag was relied on instead of the payload: non-empty DETAILED-only rule_results with presence=false rendered a STANDARD result
Supplemental wording classifier let an unrelated leading negation excuse a later unsupported claim joined by 'and'
Phase-3 discrepancy: aggregation excludes SUPPRESSION rules from eligible findings while result.py matched_rule_ids counts any MATCHED entry
